settings.title: Settings
settings.correctionFormula.terrill: Precise — Terrill cubic formula (after 1/3 of fermentation)
settings.hint: Settings apply to all screens and are saved automatically. “Auto” is the two-component physical Novotný model (correct throughout fermentation, yields ABV and true extract); Terrill is only for estimating final gravity within its domain.

termDesc.sg: SG (Specific Gravity) — specific density relative to water (water = 1.000). The primary density unit in winemaking.
termDesc.og: OG (Original Gravity) — the density of the must before yeast is added. The reference point for all calculations; stored in SG.
termDesc.fg: FG (Final Gravity) — the density after fermentation. ABV and residual sugar are computed from the OG–FG pair.
termDesc.brix: Brix (°Bx) — a sugar scale roughly equal to the percentage of sugar in the solution. The primary scale of the user's refractometers and hydrometers (АС-3 hydrometers show only °Bx).
termDesc.atc: ATC — automatic temperature compensation in a refractometer: the instrument itself adjusts readings for the sample temperature.
termDesc.wcf: WCF (Wort Correction Factor) — wort correction factor: refractometer readings are calibrated against sucrose, while real wort refracts light differently (usually 1.02–1.06). A personal WCF is derived from the calibration pair: WCF = hydrometer reading (°Bx) / refractometer reading (°Bx).
termDesc.abv: ABV (Alcohol By Volume) — alcohol strength, the volume fraction of ethanol; shown in the app as «% ABV».
termDesc.ph: pH — the acidity of the must or wine. It affects the course of fermentation, stability and taste.
termDesc.tcal: T_cal — the hydrometer calibration temperature at which it reads accurately (usually 20 °C; older models use 15 or 17.5 °C).
termDesc.ferment: Fermentation — yeast converts sugar into alcohol and CO₂. Primary fermentation is the vigorous stage; finishing fermentation is the quiet completion.

brixToSg.title: Brix → SG conversion
brixToSg.note: Bi — the corrected refractometer reading (after WCF). Implemented in the brixToSg function.

calibrationPair.title: Calibration pair (refractometer — hydrometer)
calibrationPair.note: One must sample is measured with both instruments, both readings in °Bx (the scale of АС-3 hydrometers). For example, 20 °Bx and 21 °Bx → WCF 1.05. The pair is recorded once and applied to all measurements of this refractometer.

hydrometerCorrection.title: Hydrometer reading correction (АС-3)
hydrometerCorrection.note: The reading is taken in °Bx, the instrument's calibration offset (also in °Bx) is added in the Brix scale, then the value is converted to SG (Brix → SG) — and the temperature correction is applied to that density S. Working range 15–30 °C (error ≤ 0.001 SG); below 10 °C or above 35 °C the correction is outside the approximation.

novotny.title: Refractometer correction during fermentation — two-component model (Novotný)
novotny.note: R — the current reading with WCF (°Bx), B₀ — the true starting extract (°Bx), B — true extract, A — ABV. Solved iteratively (fixed point); the result is B and A, and the apparent density SG_app (apparent extract converted to SG) goes to the chart and is comparable with a hydrometer. The model is valid throughout fermentation.

terrill.title: Refractometer correction — Terrill (manual selection)
terrill.note: Bi/Bf are RAW readings in Brix (no WCF): the Terrill regression was built on raw pairs. Applicable once fermentation has passed ~1/3 (Bf ≤ 0.6·Bi); when R > 0.6·OG the Novotný model is used.

linear.title: Refractometer correction — linear (manual selection)
linear.note: Balling's relation: OE — the true starting extract (from OG with WCF), AE — the apparent extract of the current must. Stable over the whole fermentation.

hall.title: ABV (Hall formula)
hall.note: OG/FG in SG; the result is % ABV. For batches measured with a refractometer, ABV comes from the Novotný model (from the same system of equations).
